title: Vertex AI adds Claude-specific feature controls
summary: Developers using Anthropic's Claude models on Vertex AI now have a dedicated configuration for advanced AI features and data retention opt-ins.
details: The `PublisherModelConfig` schema now includes a `claudeFeatureConfig` object. This object introduces `advancedAiEnabled`, a boolean field used to enable advanced AI features and opt-in to data retention. Simultaneously, the `cyberVerificationProgramEnabled` field has been deprecated in favor of this new, more broadly named parameter. This change indicates a shift in how Vertex AI handles the 'Cyber Verification Program' (CVP) and data retention policies specifically for the Claude model family.
